title: Meter Reading Results or Period Value as a Basis for Extrapolation

Example: Basis for Extrapolation

The period from O01 to O2 is not representative because it does not have the minimum weighting portion (only 20% rather than the
required 50%). This means that this period alone cannot be used as a basis for extrapolation. The system goes back to the next
meter reading (08). The period from O1 to 08 is representative because it has a weighting portion of 20% + 60% = 80%. The
period from 01 to 08 can be used as a basis for extrapolation.
